name: Lettie and the Lanternkeeper
source:
Move back to the island you visited during childhood. Explore the beaches, eat delicious food, and discover the mysteries of the beautiful lanternkeeper. 

[From [url=https://ponder.itch.io/lettie-and-the-lanternkeeper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搬回你童年时去过的岛屿。探索海滩、品尝美食，并揭开美丽灯塔守护者的谜团。

[来源：[url=https://ponder.itch.io/lettie-and-the-lanternkeeper]Itch.io[/url]]
